qa_pairs.question: What are the minimum device requirements to use the Chase Mobile Checkout app?
qa_pairs.answer: The minimum requirements include iOS 11 or Android 6, BLE 4, and Chase Mobile Checkout version 4.1 or later.

qa_pairs.question: Why can't I download the app?
qa_pairs.answer: Your system may not meet the minimum compatibility requirements.

qa_pairs.question: Why can't I find the app in the app store to download?
qa_pairs.answer: You must be using iOS 11 or AndroidT 6.0 to see the app in the app store.

qa_pairs.question: Why can't I sign in to the app?
qa_pairs.answer: Ensure: You have signed a merchant agreement with Chase. You have a mobile account. You are connected to the internet. You have an active username and password. Your username and password were emailed separately when your account was first activated. The password email contains a one-time use password that will require a reset when you sign in for the first time.

qa_pairs.question: Why isn't my password working?
qa_pairs.answer: Ensure: You are spelling it correctly. You enter the case correctly. You can reset your password by tapping "Forgot Password?" on the sign-in screen.

qa_pairs.question: Why can't I process transactions?
qa_pairs.answer: Ensure: You are connected to the internet. The reader hasn't been placed in airplane mode (quickly tap the button to restore it). You are in the United States and not close to a border. Your GPS and location services are not disabled.

qa_pairs.question: Why isn't the card reader working?
qa_pairs.answer: The reader can be used by only a single mobile device at a time to perform a transaction. No more than nine mobile devices can be paired to a single reader. If a tenth device is paired, then the first device will be unpaired. You also may want to ensure: The reader is fully charged. The mobile device's Bluetooth is enabled. You've paired the mobile device using the one-time pairing code of six nines (999999), and the reader is set as the default reader. The reader hasn't been placed in airplane mode (quickly tap the button to restore it). If you still cannot process transactions, try turning off your mobile device and turning it back on, then launch the app and sign in.

qa_pairs.question: How do I set up additional users or order more card readers?
qa_pairs.answer: Individual user profiles can be configured in ways that only grant them access to specific functions of Chase Mobile Checkout. To request the setup of additional users, please call Chase Mobile Checkout Support at 1-866-428-4967. To ensure the security of your sensitive data, this can only be completed by the account contact Chase Merchant Services has on record.

qa_pairs.question: What mobile devices can I use with Chase Mobile Checkout?
qa_pairs.answer: The minimum compatibility requirements are iPhoner iOS 11 or AndroidT 6.0. For using card readers, the mobile device must be Bluetooth 4.0 capable.

qa_pairs.question: Why am I asked to change my password every 90 days?
qa_pairs.answer: Using guidance from the Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard (PCI-DSS), Chase asks users to change their password every 90 days. Frequent password renewal decreases the chances for malicious individuals to gain access to your or your customers' sensitive data.

qa_pairs.question: How do I know my password is about to expire?
qa_pairs.answer: During sign-in, the app will notify you when you are five days away from your password's expiration date and again a day before your password expires. Tapping this notification will take you through the password reset process. You can skip these notifications until the password finally expires. The password can be changed at any time by tapping "Forgot Password?" on the sign-in screen.

qa_pairs.question: How do I locate my sign-in credentials?
qa_pairs.answer: Once you've signed a merchant agreement with Chase and your account is established, you'll receive two separate emails from Chase containing your username and your password. The password email contains a one-time use password that will require a reset when you sign in for the first time.

qa_pairs.question: Can I use an external app to store my account credentials?
qa_pairs.answer: Yes, utilizing the secure credential storage systems built by some third-party password managers, you can now paste your account credentials directly into the Chase Mobile Checkout sign-in page. However, it is still recommended that you take the necessary security precautions in protecting your account credentials and never leave them in a publicly accessible place.

qa_pairs.question: Can I share sign-in credentials among my employees?
qa_pairs.answer: While mobile devices and card readers can be shared by your employees, each user should have their own user credentials tied to their own email address.

qa_pairs.question: Can I sign in to my Chase Mobile Checkout account from multiple mobile devices?
qa_pairs.answer: Yes, but you may need to complete the device authentication process whenever you access Chase Mobile Checkout from a new mobile device for the first time.

qa_pairs.question: Will my current sign-in credentials work each time a new version of Chase Mobile Checkout is released?
qa_pairs.answer: Yes. We frequently issue new versions to ensure the app is up to date with security and feature enhancements. Simply visit the Appler App Storer or Google PlayT Store to download the new version and receive the latest updates.

qa_pairs.question: Will my current sign-in credentials ever expire?
qa_pairs.answer: Yes. Please keep your Chase Mobile Checkout credentials active by signing in at least every 90 days. Otherwise, your mobile account will be locked and you'll need to reset your password.

qa_pairs.question: How do I get a card reader?
qa_pairs.answer: Contact the Chase Mobile Checkout Support team at 1-866-428-4967 to request a card reader.

qa_pairs.question: Why am I no longer prompted for a signature during transactions?
qa_pairs.answer: Starting in April 2018, payment brands made signature capture optional for all EMV-enabled card readers. Now, when using our card reader, the signature is no longer required for EMV/Chip or magnetic stripe-based transactions. You can enable signature capture in Settings under "Signature Settings" if you prefer.

qa_pairs.question: What are AVS settings and how do I enable them?
qa_pairs.answer: Address Verification Service (AVS) is a service provided by the payment brands that determines the match or partial match of the consumer's address information. The responses are returned during the authorization process via your transaction processing software/hardware, helping you determine whether to approve, reject, or flag the transaction. You can enable AVS in Chase Mobile Checkout by visiting Settings, then Transaction Settings.

qa_pairs.question: How do I set up my unique tip and tax settings?
qa_pairs.answer: Chase Mobile Checkout can prompt for a tip during each transaction. This setting can be customized to allow customers to select from up to three suggested tip amounts. You can also create unique tax settings per product or on the entire purchase amount.

qa_pairs.question: Can I accept transactions outside of the U.S. with Chase Mobile Checkout?
qa_pairs.answer: Chase Mobile Checkout can only be used by U.S. and Canadian merchants. The app is only available for U.S.-based businesses. There is a separate app available for businesses located in Canada. Contact Chase for more information on setting up an account for use in Canada.

qa_pairs.question: Can I add my business logo to my receipts?
qa_pairs.answer: Yes, and it is recommended to enhance brand recognition. You can customize your receipts by adding your business logo in the "Set up and customize your receipts" section. Make sure your logo file is no larger than 75px high x 350px wide and no bigger than 80 KB in file size.

qa_pairs.question: Do I need a network connection to process transactions?
qa_pairs.answer: Yes. You will need access to a cellular network or internet connection to process transactions. Additionally, location services must be enabled on your mobile device to process payments.

qa_pairs.question: Why am I seeing the notification "Card Reader Not Responding"?
qa_pairs.answer: Once a card reader is selected in Settings, the app expects it to be on and available during the transaction process. This notification is displayed if the app cannot communicate with the card reader, often due to lost data connection or power. If communications do not recover, try the troubleshooting steps outlined in the app's help section.

qa_pairs.question: Can I use my Chase Mobile Checkout card reader with Online POS Terminal?
qa_pairs.answer: No. The Chase Mobile Checkout card reader is only for use with a mobile device and cannot be used with a computer-based card processing app. Contact Chase at 1-866-428-4967 to discuss purchasing a separate reader for Online POS Terminal (OPT) or a receipt printer for your computer.

qa_pairs.question: How do I charge my Ingenico Move/5000 card reader?
qa_pairs.answer: 1. Unpack the reader, charger, and base or accessories. 2. Ensure the reader is powered OFF. 3. Connect the wall/power charger to the card reader directly [A] or to a base [B], [C]. 4. Charge the reader for 16 hours.

qa_pairs.question: How do I pair the Ingenico Move/5000 card reader with a Bluetooth base?
qa_pairs.answer: 1. Ensure the card reader is fully charged before pairing. 2. If you purchased a communications base separately, follow these instructions: - Press the square gray Home Menu key to access the Admin Menu. - Select Admin Mode and enter the Admin Password. - Select Tetra Admin. - Select [5] for Configure Bluetooth. - Select [1] for Base. 3. To add a base: - Select [1] to ADD base from the Admin Menu. - Place the reader on the corresponding base (cradle) to complete the pairing process. - If the pairing is successful, no further action is needed. 4. To select a base: - Select [2] to SELECT base from the Admin Menu. - Choose the base by matching the value to the last 7 digits of the S/N value located on the bottom of the base. - If there are multiple bases, the card reader will display values for the additional bases.

qa_pairs.question: How do I remove a Bluetooth base from the Ingenico Move/5000 card reader?
qa_pairs.answer: 1. Follow these instructions only if you purchased a communications base separately: - Press the square gray Home Menu key to access the Admin Menu. - Select Admin Mode and enter the Admin Password. - Select Tetra Admin. - Select [5] for Configure Bluetooth. - Select [1] for Base. 2. To remove a paired base: - Press the square green key to complete the removal process. - Once removal is complete, no further action is needed.

qa_pairs.question: How do I pair the Ingenico Move/5000 card reader with Wi-Fi?
qa_pairs.answer: 1. Follow the instructions provided in the user guide or access in-reader support by pressing the gray Admin key. 2. Press anywhere on the screen and swipe from right to left. 3. The Self-Help icon will display; press the icon to begin the in-reader support for Wi-Fi pairing.

qa_pairs.question: How do I process a sale with the Ingenico Move/5000 card reader?
qa_pairs.answer: 1. Press the square green key to access the main menu. 2. Press [0] or the blue shopping cart "Sale" icon on the touch screen. 3. Enter the sale amount and press the square green key. 4. Customers can tap, insert, or swipe their card. If a chip card is used, leave it inserted until instructed to remove it. 5. When the screen says "Approved," customers will be prompted to remove their card. 6. Your receipt will automatically print. To print a customer’s receipt, press the square green key. If no selection is made after 30 seconds, a receipt will print automatically. 7. When the sale is complete, the main menu will reappear.

qa_pairs.question: How do I process a return or refund with the Ingenico Move/5000 card reader?
qa_pairs.answer: 1. Press the square green key to access the main menu. 2. Press [1] or the blue package carrier "Return" icon on the touch screen. 3. Enter the supervisor password and press the square green key. 4. Enter the return amount and press the square green key. 5. Customers can tap, insert, or swipe their card. If a chip card is used, leave it inserted until instructed to remove it. 6. When the transaction is approved, your receipt will automatically print. 7. If a signature is required, have the customer sign your copy of the receipt. 8. Press the square green key again to print the customer’s receipt, if desired. If no selection is made after 30 seconds, a receipt will print automatically. 9. When the return is complete, the main menu will reappear.

qa_pairs.question: How do I include a tip in a sale with the Ingenico Move/5000 card reader?
qa_pairs.answer: 1. Pass the card reader to the customer to enter the tip amount. 2. The customer can press [1] for tip percentage, [2] for tip amount, or [0] for no tip. 3. The customer enters the tip amount and presses [1] to Accept or [2] to Change. 4. The customer then taps, inserts, or swipes their card. Note: If you need to configure your card reader to process tips, please call 1-888-886-8869 to speak with a specialist.

qa_pairs.question: How do I void a sale on the Ingenico Move/5000 card reader?
qa_pairs.answer: 1. Press the square green key to access the main menu. 2. Press [2] or the blue shopping cart with a line going through it "Void" icon on the touch screen. 3. Enter the supervisor password and press the square green key. 4. Use the search menu to locate transactions by selecting: - [1] - All - [2] - Reference # - [3] - Clerk # - [4] - Invoice #/PO# - [5] - Account # - [6] - Customer # - [7] - RRN - [8] - Approval code 5. Enter the relevant information based on transaction type and press the square green key. 6. If "ALL" is selected, use the arrow keys to scroll through transactions and press the square green key to select the transaction to be voided. 7. The card reader will prompt you to confirm the void amount. Press [1] for YES or [2] for NO. 8. Once the void is confirmed, your receipt will automatically print. 9. To print a customer’s receipt, press the square green key. If no selection is made after 30 seconds, a receipt will print automatically. 10. When the void is complete, the main menu will reappear.

qa_pairs.question: How do I change the date or time on my Ingenico Move/5000 card reader?
qa_pairs.answer: 1. The admin passcode may be required to update the date and time. 2. Press the gray/white Admin Key to access the Admin Menu, then select Admin Mode. 3. If prompted, input the Admin passcode and press the green enter key. 4. To change the date and time: - Select Tetra Admin, then select Set Date and Time. - To change the date: Input 6 digits for the two-digit day, two-digit month, and two-digit year, then press Enter. Be careful when entering the date and time, as an invalid year may render the terminal inoperable. - To change the time: Use a military time format to input 4 total digits, 2 for the hour and 2 for the minute, then press Enter. 5. The card reader may prompt to reboot for the changes to take effect and return to the idle screen once restarted.

qa_pairs.question: What is the Chase Mobile Card Reader and how does it work?
qa_pairs.answer: The Chase Mobile Card Reader is a Black MagTek eDynamo device used with the Chase Mobile Checkout app. It works with Chase Mobile Checkout App version 4.0 or later and connects via Bluetooth.

qa_pairs.question: How do I pair the Chase Mobile Card Reader with my device?
qa_pairs.answer: To pair the card reader, ensure Bluetooth is enabled on your device. In the Chase Mobile Checkout app, go to Settings, tap Card Readers, and then press and hold the button on the card reader for two seconds to enter pairing mode. Locate the card reader's serial number and select it in the app, then enter the default pairing code (999999) and tap Pair. Toggle on the Set As Current Device switch when the status changes to Connected.

qa_pairs.question: What should I do once my card reader arrives?
qa_pairs.answer: Charge the card reader for three hours using the provided USB cable. The LED will blink green while charging and turn solid green when fully charged. The reader can be used while charging.

qa_pairs.question: How do I navigate the Chase Mobile Checkout app?
qa_pairs.answer: The app home screen defaults to the NEW SALE screen. You can access features like New Sale, Edit Catalog, Sales Activity, Other Reports, Settings, Notifications, and Support by tapping the menu icon at the top left of your screen.

qa_pairs.question: How do I customize my payments experience in the Chase Mobile Checkout app?
qa_pairs.answer: Go to the SETTINGS screen to customize transaction settings, enable signature prompts, set tip percentages and tax rates, manage electronic receipts, and establish pairing relationships for multiple card readers.

qa_pairs.question: How do I create and manage my product catalog?
qa_pairs.answer: Tap Edit Catalog from the main navigation menu. To create or edit an item, enter its name, price, and category. You can also add a photo of the item and save it to your catalog.

qa_pairs.question: How can I customize my receipts in Chase Mobile Checkout?
qa_pairs.answer: Go to Settings and select Receipts. Upload a PNG logo (75px high x 350px wide, no larger than 80 KB), and edit the receipt Header and Footer fields. Tap Update to confirm changes.

qa_pairs.question: How do I process a quick sale using Chase Mobile Checkout?
qa_pairs.answer: From the NEW SALE screen, enter the amount or select items from your Product Catalog. Review the order, apply any discounts or taxes, then tap Checkout. Connect to your card reader to capture payment, authorize the transaction, and send a receipt if enabled.

qa_pairs.question: How can I set up and apply sales tax options in the app?
qa_pairs.answer: From the Settings menu, select Taxes, toggle on the option to apply tax, and add new tax rates. You can set up to three tax amounts and apply them to individual items or the entire order.

qa_pairs.question: How do I apply discounts in Chase Mobile Checkout?
qa_pairs.answer: Toggle on the Discounts switch in the SETTINGS screen. You can apply discounts to the total sale or individual items by selecting the appropriate option in the REVIEW ORDER screen.

qa_pairs.question: What steps should I follow to process a refund or void a transaction?
qa_pairs.answer: Select Sales Activity from the main menu, find the transaction date, and view Transaction Details. Tap Refund or Void, select the amount, and have the customer sign for the transaction. Enter the customer's email or phone number to send a digital receipt.

qa_pairs.question: How can I view sales activity and settlement reports?
qa_pairs.answer: Access Sales Activity from the main navigation menu to view transaction details. Settlement reports are available through chase.com/business or your business's reporting solution. Chase Mobile Checkout automatically settles transactions daily at 11:30 p.m. EST.

qa_pairs.question: How do I resend a receipt to a customer?
qa_pairs.answer: Go to Sales Activity, select the transaction date, find the transaction, and tap Resend Receipt. Confirm or update the customer's email or phone number, and the receipt will be resent to both you and the customer.

qa_pairs.question: What should I do if I can't download the Chase Mobile Checkout app?
qa_pairs.answer: Ensure your system meets the minimum compatibility requirements. If you're unable to find the app in the app store, verify that you are using iOS 11 or AndroidT 6.0 or later.

qa_pairs.question: What should I check if I can't sign in to the Chase Mobile Checkout app?
qa_pairs.answer: Confirm the following: You have signed a merchant agreement with Chase. You have a mobile account. You are connected to the internet. You have an active username and password. Your username and password were emailed separately when your account was activated. The password email contains a one-time use password that will require a reset on your first sign-in.

qa_pairs.question: What can I do if my password isn't working?
qa_pairs.answer: Ensure that you are spelling the password correctly and entering it with the correct case. If needed, you can reset your password by tapping "Forgot Password?" on the sign-in screen.

qa_pairs.question: What should I do if I can't process transactions?
qa_pairs.answer: Verify that: You are connected to the internet. The card reader has not been placed in airplane mode (tap the button to restore it). You are within the United States and not near a border. Your GPS and location services are enabled.

qa_pairs.question: What if the card reader doesn't seem to be working?
qa_pairs.answer: Ensure that: The card reader is fully charged. Bluetooth is enabled on your mobile device. The reader has been paired with your mobile device using the one-time pairing code (999999) and is set as the default reader. The reader is not in airplane mode (tap the button to restore it).

qa_pairs.question: How do I set up additional users or order more card readers?
qa_pairs.answer: To request the setup of additional users or order more card readers: Call Chase Mobile Checkout Support at 1-866-428-4967. Only the account contact Chase Merchant Services has on record can complete this request to ensure the security of your sensitive data.

qa_pairs.question: What mobile devices can I use with Chase Mobile Checkout?
qa_pairs.answer: The minimum compatibility requirements for Chase Mobile Checkout are iPhoner iOS 11 or AndroidT 6.0. For using card readers, the mobile device must support Bluetooth 4.0 or later.

qa_pairs.question: Why am I asked to change my password every 90 days?
qa_pairs.answer: This policy follows the Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard (PCI-DSS) guidelines. Frequent password changes reduce the risk of unauthorized access to sensitive data.

qa_pairs.question: How do I know my password is about to expire?
qa_pairs.answer: The app will notify you when you are five days away from your password's expiration date and again a day before it expires. Tapping this notification will guide you through the password reset process. You can also reset your password anytime by tapping "Forgot Password?" on the sign-in screen.

qa_pairs.question: How do I locate my sign-in credentials?
qa_pairs.answer: After signing a merchant agreement with Chase and establishing your account, you will receive two separate emails containing your username and a one-time use password. The password will need to be reset when you sign in for the first time.

qa_pairs.question: Can I use an external app to store my account credentials?
qa_pairs.answer: Yes, you can use secure credential storage systems from third-party password managers to paste your credentials into the sign-in page. However, it's recommended to protect your credentials carefully and avoid storing them in publicly-accessible places.

qa_pairs.question: Can I share sign-in credentials among my employees?
qa_pairs.answer: While mobile devices and card readers can be shared, each employee should have their own user credentials linked to their own email address for security purposes.

qa_pairs.question: Can I sign in to my Chase Mobile Checkout account from multiple mobile devices?
qa_pairs.answer: Yes, but you may need to complete the device authentication process each time you access CMC from a new mobile device. Refer to the setup instructions for details on device authentication.

qa_pairs.question: Will my current sign-in credentials work with new versions of CMC?
qa_pairs.answer: Yes, your credentials will continue to work with new versions of CMC. Simply download the latest version from the Appler App Storer or Google PlayT Store to receive updates.

qa_pairs.question: Will my current sign-in credentials ever expire?
qa_pairs.answer: To keep your credentials active, sign in at least every 90 days. Otherwise, your account will be locked, and you will need to reset your password.

qa_pairs.question: How do I get a card reader?
qa_pairs.answer: Contact Chase Mobile Checkout Support at 1-866-428-4967 to request a card reader.

qa_pairs.question: Why am I no longer prompted for a signature during transactions?
qa_pairs.answer: Since April 2018, signature capture has become optional for EMV-enabled card readers. You can enable signature capture in the app's Settings under Signature Settings.

qa_pairs.question: What are AVS settings and how do I enable them?
qa_pairs.answer: Address Verification Service (AVS) checks if the consumer's address information matches the records during authorization. You can modify AVS settings in the app by going to Settings and then Transaction Settings.

qa_pairs.question: How do I set up my unique tip and tax settings?
qa_pairs.answer: CMC allows you to prompt for tips during transactions and create up to three suggested tip amounts. You can also set up unique tax settings for individual products or for the entire purchase amount.

qa_pairs.question: Does Chase Mobile Checkout allow me to accept transactions outside of the U.S.?
qa_pairs.answer: Chase Mobile Checkout is only available for U.S.-based businesses. Canadian businesses need a separate app. Contact Chase Mobile Checkout Support for more information about setting up an account in Canada.

qa_pairs.question: Can I add my business logo to my receipts?
qa_pairs.answer: Yes, you can add your business logo to receipts. Refer to the "Set up and customize your receipts" section for details. Logos must be in PNG format, no larger than 75px high x 350px wide, and not exceed 80 KB.

qa_pairs.question: Do I need a network connection to process transactions?
qa_pairs.answer: Yes, a cellular network or internet connection is required to process transactions. Location services must also be enabled on your mobile device.

qa_pairs.question: Why do I see the notification "Card Reader Not Responding"?
qa_pairs.answer: This notification appears if the app cannot communicate with the card reader due to lost data connection or power issues. Check for connectivity issues and refer to the troubleshooting section for further assistance.

qa_pairs.question: Can I use my Chase Mobile Checkout card reader with Online POS Terminal?
qa_pairs.answer: No, the Chase Mobile Checkout card reader is only for use with a mobile device. Contact Chase Mobile Checkout Support at 1-866-428-4967 to discuss purchasing a separate reader for Online POS Terminal (OPT) or a receipt printer for your computer.

qa_pairs.question: How do I activate a gift card?
qa_pairs.answer: To activate a gift card, follow these steps: Select Activation from the Gift card menu. Enter the card number, amount, and any additional details required. Click the Next button. On the Response page, confirm the activation approval.

qa_pairs.question: Can I activate multiple gift cards at once?
qa_pairs.answer: Yes, you can activate multiple gift cards by entering the first card number and then specifying the number of additional cards in the Number of additional cards field. For block transactions, you can view the status of your request in blocks of 100 cards by clicking the Block Activation Summary results link.

qa_pairs.question: How do I reactivate a gift card?
qa_pairs.answer: To reactivate a gift card, select Reactivation from the Gift card menu, fill in the necessary fields, and submit the transaction.

qa_pairs.question: When should I deactivate a gift card?
qa_pairs.answer: You should deactivate a gift card if it has been lost or stolen to prevent it from being redeemed. This will allow you to issue a new gift card to the customer.

qa_pairs.question: How do I issue a gift card?
qa_pairs.answer: To issue a gift card: Select Issue or add value from the Gift card menu. Enter the card number, amount, and any additional details. Ensure the New issuance or add value radio button is selected. Click the Checkout button. On the Response page, review the issuance details and whether it was approved or declined. Optionally, enter the customer's mobile number or email for a digital receipt and choose to print receipts if desired.

qa_pairs.question: What should I do if I can't access Online POS Terminal but need to issue a gift card?
qa_pairs.answer: If you can't access Online POS Terminal, you can use voice authorization: Call 1-888-959-1493 to receive an approval code. Perform the Prior Issuance process by selecting Issue or add value, choosing the Force issuance or add value radio button, entering card details and the approval code, and then clicking the Checkout button.

qa_pairs.question: How do I redeem a gift card?
qa_pairs.answer: To redeem a gift card: Select Redemption from the Gift card menu. Enter the card number, amount, and any additional details. Ensure the New redemption radio button is selected. Click the Checkout button. On the Response page, review the redemption details and whether it was approved or declined. Optionally, enter the customer's mobile number or email for a digital receipt and choose to print receipts if desired.

qa_pairs.question: What should I do if I can't access Online POS Terminal but need to redeem a gift card?
qa_pairs.answer: If you can't access Online POS Terminal, use voice authorization: Call 1-888-959-1493 to get an approval code. Perform the Prior Redemption process by selecting Redemption, choosing the Force redemption radio button, entering card details and the approval code, and then clicking the Checkout button.

qa_pairs.question: How do I check the balance of a gift card?
qa_pairs.answer: To check the balance of a gift card: Select Balance inquiry from the Gift card menu. Enter the card information by swiping or manually entering the numbers. Review the card details and current balance on the response screen. Alternatively, customers can call the Interactive Voice Response System at 1-800-242-5353 to check the balance and recent transactions.

qa_pairs.question: How can I provide receipts to customers after a transaction?
qa_pairs.answer: After processing a transaction, you can provide receipts in several ways: Text: Enter the customer's 10-digit phone number and click the Send Receipt button. A text message will be sent from short code "27359" with transaction details. Email: Enter the customer's email address and click the Send Receipt button. An email with the receipt as an image file will be sent from "DoNotReply@billing-notification.com." Print: Click Print Customer Receipt, Print Merchant Receipt, or Print Both to print copies of the receipt. The Epson TM-T20II thermal receipt printer is recommended.

qa_pairs.question: How do I process a refund using Online POS Terminal?
qa_pairs.answer: To process a refund: Click the New transaction tab. Select the Refund tab. Complete the required fields marked with an asterisk. Click the Issue refund button to finalize the transaction.

qa_pairs.question: How do I manually settle open transactions in Quick Batch View?
qa_pairs.answer: To settle open transactions manually: Click the Quick Batch view icon to see a snapshot of your open batch. In the Open Batch section, click View Items to see all open transactions, or click Settle Batch to manually settle the batch. If there are rejected transactions, click View Items to see them or Re-Settle to address any issues after correcting account settings.

qa_pairs.question: What is the batch life cycle for transactions?
qa_pairs.answer: The batch life cycle includes: Open: Transactions are collected and either manually settled or automatically closed. Pending: Transactions are grouped into a batch with a Pending status. Closed or Rejected: The batch is considered Closed if it settles properly or Rejected if it does not. You can view items and settle batches manually or view and resettle rejected transactions.

qa_pairs.question: How can I view and manage transactions in the Back Office?
qa_pairs.answer: In the Back Office: Transaction Management: Use the Transactions drop-down menu to search by All, Open, Pending, or Rejected items. You can filter by Date range, Account number, or Amount range. Calendar: Use the Date range to pull up the calendar and select the date to review transactions. Void: If a transaction is in an open batch, you can highlight it and select Void to remove it without charging the customer. Refund: For transactions in a closed batch, you can highlight it and select Refund to refund the full or partial amount of the original purchase.

qa_pairs.question: How do I generate and access reports from Online POS Terminal?
qa_pairs.answer: To generate and access reports: Reporting: Select Report from the Transactions menu, choose CSV for Excel export or PDF for printing. Batch History: Access Batch history by selecting a Date Range or Batch Range. Queued Reports: Reports will show as Queued until complete, at which point the status will update to Complete. Card Type Summary: View card type activity by day, week, month, or quarter. Sales Trends: View transaction activity by selecting Sales trends and searching by Date range.

qa_pairs.question: What should I do if the screen locks up during a transaction?
qa_pairs.answer: If the screen locks up: Right-click your mouse. Select Reload page. Repeat the previous steps to complete the transaction.

qa_pairs.question: What support is available if I need help with Online POS Terminal?
qa_pairs.answer: For support: Call 1-800-503-1132 for assistance from customer service. For questions about fees or general support, visit chase.com/ManageMyMerchantAccount.

qa_pairs.question: What is Online POS Terminal, and how can it benefit my business?
qa_pairs.answer: Online POS Terminal is a browser-based application that allows you to process card-present transactions using a PC or laptop with an Internet connection and Ingenico iPP 320 PIN Pad. It simplifies payment processing, supports various transaction functions, and offers secure login and thermal receipt printing. It also provides options for auto or manual batch settlement and quick transaction retrieval.

qa_pairs.question: What costs are associated with using Online POS Terminal?
qa_pairs.answer: Costs vary based on your specific needs and merchant service agreement. There is no standard cost as it is customized for each business.

qa_pairs.question: Does Online POS Terminal offer fraud-detection services?
qa_pairs.answer: Yes, Online POS Terminal supports: Address Verification Service (AVS): Compares the customer's billing address with the address on file with the credit card company. Card Verification Data: Uses a code printed on the card to verify transactions where the physical card is not present.

qa_pairs.question: Can I process purchasing cards with Online POS Terminal?
qa_pairs.answer: Yes, Online POS Terminal supports processing purchasing cards with Level II data.

qa_pairs.question: Can Online POS Terminal be used outside of the office?
qa_pairs.answer: Yes, Online POS Terminal can be accessed from anywhere with a secure Internet connection and a web browser.

qa_pairs.question: How long does Online POS Terminal store transaction history?
qa_pairs.answer: Online POS Terminal stores transaction history for six months. You can search by card account number, invoice number, or date range.

qa_pairs.question: Can I access merchant statements from Online POS Terminal?
qa_pairs.answer: No, while you can retrieve batch totals and transaction details, financial statements are accessed through your Chase online account.

qa_pairs.question: Does Online POS Terminal support other payment processors?
qa_pairs.answer: No, Online POS Terminal is a proprietary system of Chase and is only available to Chase merchants. To use it, you must have a Chase merchant account.

qa_pairs.question: If I have an existing merchant account with Chase, can I use Online POS Terminal?
qa_pairs.answer: In some cases, existing merchant numbers can be used to set up Online POS Terminal access. However, new identification numbers may be required in other cases.

qa_pairs.question: Is Online POS Terminal available 24/7?
qa_pairs.answer: Yes, Online POS Terminal is available 24/7 with an automatic time-out feature after 15 minutes of inactivity for security purposes.

qa_pairs.question: Can I have multiple Online POS Terminal accounts?
qa_pairs.answer: Yes, you can have multiple Online POS Terminal accounts, each associated with a different merchant identification number. The system also supports multiple terminals for managing separate batches.

qa_pairs.question: Do I need to close out the terminal every day?
qa_pairs.answer: Yes, you must settle batches daily. You can either do this manually or enable Auto Settle during setup for automatic daily batch closure.

qa_pairs.question: How do I correct an error in data entry?
qa_pairs.answer: If you make an error, you can use the Void feature to reverse transactions within an open batch or issue a refund for transactions already settled.

qa_pairs.question: Where can I get support if I have questions?
qa_pairs.answer: For support, contact the staffed support center 24/7 at 800.934.7717 or use the toll-free number and email address provided during setup.

qa_pairs.question: How do I process a sale with a voice authorization?
qa_pairs.answer: If there's a power failure or system outage, you can continue authorizing sales using the voice authorization system. Once the system is back up, add the voice authorization detail to your Orbital Virtual Terminal batch using a force transaction. On the New Order menu, select "Force." Enter the card number, expiration date, card verification number, sale amount, and a unique order ID. In the Prior Auth Approval Code field, enter the number received from the voice authorization system. Enter any other required transaction information and click either "Force" to put a hold on funds or "Force and Capture" to include the transaction in the next settled batch.

qa_pairs.question: How do I verify an account?
qa_pairs.answer: On the New Order menu, select "Account Verification." Enter the cardholder information and click the Verify button.

qa_pairs.question: How do I view batch and transaction details?
qa_pairs.answer: To view details in an open batch, click the "Open Batch" menu option. To view details for a closed batch or transactions, select "Batch Search" or "Transaction Search" under the Review menu. Enter or select your report criteria, select "Detailed Transactions" from the Query Type dropdown, and click the Search button. Then select the appropriate item and click the "Batch Details" or "View Order" command button.

qa_pairs.question: How do I create customer profiles?
qa_pairs.answer: On the Admin menu, select "Profile Management" and click the "New Profile" button. Enter the necessary information for the customer. To enable recurring payments, select the "Add Managed Billing - Recurring" checkbox. To customize the billing pattern, select the "Override Defaults" checkbox and specify the new pattern. Click the Add button when finished. You can also create a profile when processing a transaction by selecting the "Add to Profile Management" checkbox on the New Order page.

qa_pairs.question: How do I set up managed billing?
qa_pairs.answer: On the Admin menu, select "Profile > Managed Billing." Create a billing pattern based on day, week, or month, and click the Save button. This pattern will apply to all customer profiles enabled for recurring payments. To alter or enable recurring payments for a specific profile, select "Profile Management" from the Admin menu, search for the profile, and click "Edit/View Profile." Select the "Add Managed Billing - Recurring" checkbox and customize the billing pattern if needed. Click the Add button when finished.

qa_pairs.question: How do I set up additional users?
qa_pairs.answer: Contact Gateway Support at 1-800-254-9556 to request the setup of additional users. Account verification and contact authentication will be required.

qa_pairs.question: How do I locate my merchant number?
qa_pairs.answer: Your merchant number (Merchant ID) is located across the top-middle of the Virtual Terminal screen above any transaction information and on the front of your merchant statement, available in the online reporting application, Resource Online.

qa_pairs.question: How do I get additional help?
qa_pairs.answer: For technical trouble, contact Gateway Support at 1-800-254-9556. For questions about fees or general support, call Chase Merchant Services at 1.888.886.8869.

qa_pairs.question: What is Virtual Terminal?
qa_pairs.answer: The Orbitalr Virtual Terminal is a Web-based application for key-entered transactions and payment management functions, replacing a physical POS system. It requires only a computer with a secure Internet connection and a Web browser.

qa_pairs.question: What are the features of the Virtual Terminal?
qa_pairs.answer: It simplifies payments infrastructure, supports credit card transactions (authorization, refunds, voids), provides batch and transaction management, allows automatic or manual batch settlement, offers quick order retrieval, and ensures secure login with multi-tiered access.

qa_pairs.question: Does the virtual terminal support card-not-present transactions?
qa_pairs.answer: Yes, the Orbital Virtual Terminal supports card-not-present transactions, including authorization only, authorization and capture, refunds, and voids. It also supports card-present and PIN debit transactions.

qa_pairs.question: Does the Orbital Virtual Terminal offer fraud detection services?
qa_pairs.answer: Yes, it supports Address Verification System (AVS), Card Verification values (CVV, CVV2, CID), and Account Verification.

qa_pairs.question: Can I process purchasing cards?
qa_pairs.answer: Yes, you can process purchasing cards with Level II and Level III data via the Virtual Terminal.

qa_pairs.question: Can I process electronic checks with Orbital Virtual Terminal?
qa_pairs.answer: Your company may be able to process electronic checks.

qa_pairs.question: Can I process in currencies other than U.S. dollars?
qa_pairs.answer: Your company may qualify for international currency services.

qa_pairs.question: Can I issue refunds through the Orbital Virtual Terminal?
qa_pairs.answer: Yes, select the "Credit" option from the New Order menu, enter the required data, and click the Credit button. You can also perform a quick credit by looking up transactions under the Review tab.

qa_pairs.question: Can I use the Orbital Virtual Terminal outside my office, such as at a tradeshow?
qa_pairs.answer: Yes, you can access the Orbital Virtual Terminal from anywhere with a secure Internet connection and a Web browser.

qa_pairs.question: Can I use the Orbital Virtual Terminal to authorize items and then settle them through another processing interface?
qa_pairs.answer: Some merchants can use this feature, but it is mandatory to include the original authorization code and date, order number, merchant ID, and card number in the settlement process. Contact your Relationship Manager or call 800.708.3740 for more information.

qa_pairs.question: Is transaction history retained?
qa_pairs.answer: Yes, the Orbital Virtual Terminal stores transaction history for six months. You can search by card account number, order number, or date range.

qa_pairs.question: Are merchant statements available with the Orbital Virtual Terminal?
qa_pairs.answer: No, merchant statements are not available from the Virtual Terminal. For financial and settlement reports, discuss with your Relationship Manager or call 800.708.3740.

qa_pairs.question: Does Orbital Virtual Terminal support other payment processors?
qa_pairs.answer: No, it is a proprietary system of Chase Merchant Services and is only available to their merchant base.

qa_pairs.question: If I have an existing merchant account with Chase Merchant Services, can I use Orbital Virtual Terminal?
qa_pairs.answer: In some cases, existing merchant numbers can be used. Contact your Relationship Manager to find out if a new ID is needed.

qa_pairs.question: How long does it take to set up the Virtual Terminal?
qa_pairs.answer: The Virtual Terminal is typically activated within 48 hours after your merchant account is approved and set up.

qa_pairs.question: Is the system available for use anytime?
qa_pairs.answer: Yes, the system is available 24/7 with an automatic time-out feature after 20 minutes of inactivity.

qa_pairs.question: Do I need separate logins for multiple users?
qa_pairs.answer: Yes, each user is provided a unique login with flexible access permissions. You can establish different levels of access for different users.

qa_pairs.question: Can I have multiple Virtual Terminals?
qa_pairs.answer: Yes, each Orbital Virtual Terminal account represents one merchant ID. You can have multiple Virtual Terminals for different merchant IDs.

qa_pairs.question: Does the terminal capture items to be charged to a cardholder?
qa_pairs.answer: Yes, if you only authorize an item, you need to mark it for capture. If the item was processed as an authorize-and-capture transaction, no additional steps are needed.

qa_pairs.question: Do I have to close out the terminal every day?
qa_pairs.answer: Yes, you must close out the terminal daily by either logging in and closing batches or setting up an Auto-Close option.

qa_pairs.question: Does the system report activity by user login?
qa_pairs.answer: Yes, you can search and generate reports based on user login activity.

qa_pairs.question: How do I authorize a card?
qa_pairs.answer: After logging in, use the New Order screen to either authorize only or authorize and capture a card transaction.

qa_pairs.question: How do I charge a cardholder?
qa_pairs.answer: Authorize and capture the transaction. You can choose to do this in one step or separately. Ensure you settle open batches manually or with the auto-close feature.

qa_pairs.question: If I make an error entering data, how do I correct it?
qa_pairs.answer: If you haven't executed the function yet, use the Clear button to start over. If completed, use the Void feature to cancel the transaction.

qa_pairs.question: If I have a question, where do I go for support?
qa_pairs.answer: For support questions, you can use the toll-free number and email address provided at setup, available 24/7.

qa_pairs.question: How do I connect my Verifone card reader?
qa_pairs.answer: 1. Select a location for your Verifone card reader near a power outlet and an Internet router, modem, or wall jack that is convenient for the operator and offers adequate ventilation and protection for the equipment. - If you are using the charging base for the Bluetooth card reader, follow the same instructions to connect the base and select a location. - If you are connecting your Verifone card reader to a telephone line, plug one end of a standard telephone cord into the phone port on the card reader and the other end into your telephone wall jack. **Note:** For optimal performance, we suggest using the provided phone cable on a dedicated phone line, and not connecting through a splitter. 2. If you are going to use an Internet connection, plug one end of an Ethernet cable into the card reader's Ethernet port, which may be labeled as "ETH" or "10Base-T." Plug the other end into your router, modem, or Ethernet wall jack. **Note:** You can connect both Internet and phone cables to the Verifone card reader so that it can automatically switch over in the event of Internet connectivity problems. 3. Make sure that one end of the power cord is plugged into the adapter, and then plug the other end into an indoor outlet. - Attach the small plug on the adapter cord to the power port on the rear of the Verifone card reader. **Important:** Never plug a PIN pad into a powered-on card reader – it could damage the equipment. For assistance connecting a peripheral PIN pad to your Verifone card reader, please contact the Help Desk at 1-888-886-8869.

qa_pairs.question: What are the payment processing methods available on the Verifone card reader?
qa_pairs.answer: 1. **Insert:** If the customer has an EMV chip card, and your Verifone card reader is enabled to accept EMV transactions, the customer should insert their card into the chip card slot, which is on the front of the card reader, beneath the colored keys. 2. **Swipe:** The customer can swipe their card down the magnetic-stripe reader on the right side of the Verifone card reader. 3. **Tap:** If the customer has a contactless payment instrument, such as a contactless card or a mobile wallet on a smartphone, they should tap or wave it directly over the card reader's display screen. 4. **Manual Entry:** You can key the card number into the Verifone card reader if the card or card reader does not accept the other transmission methods, but this could cause the transaction to downgrade and incur a higher interchange fee. **Note:** Steps may differ slightly if you're using a separate PIN pad with your Verifone card reader.

qa_pairs.question: How do I manually key in a sale (card-not-present transaction) on the Verifone card reader?
qa_pairs.answer: 1. Select "Sale" from the main menu. 2. Enter the sale amount using the keypad and press Enter. If prompted to pass the terminal to the customer, bypass by pressing Enter again. 3. When prompted to Tap/Insert/Swipe/Key, simply enter the card number using the keypad. 4. Enter the card expiration date, then press Enter. 5. Enter the CVV security code, then press Enter. 6. Enter the customer Zip code associated with the cardholder’s address. When you hit Enter, you will see "Dialing/Connecting…"

qa_pairs.question: How do I refund a transaction on the Verifone VX680 card reader?
qa_pairs.answer: 1. Select "Refund" from the main screen. 2. Enter the dollar amount of the refund. 3. Confirm the refund amount. 4. Select "Yes" to confirm. 5. Press the green [Enter] key. 6. A receipt will print to complete the transaction.

qa_pairs.question: How do I void a transaction on the Verifone card reader?
qa_pairs.answer: For VX520: 1. From the main screen, press [F4] to select "Void." 2. To void the most recent transaction, press [F1]. - Review the transaction and once confirmed, press [F1] again to void it. 3. If you want to void a different transaction, search for it by pressing [F2]. - Press [F1] to search in the current batch of unsettled transactions. - Press [F2] to search for authorization-only transactions. - Once you've selected the proper batch of transactions, press [F1] to search by invoice number, or press [F2] to search by account number. - When the transaction detail displays, review the transaction and once confirmed, press [F1] to void it. For VX680: 1. Select "Void" from the menu screen. 2. To void the last transaction, select "Yes." 3. Confirm the "Yes" screen is displaying the correct void amount, and enter the last four digits of the customer's card number. 4. Press "Yes" to confirm. 5. The receipt will print and the void is complete. 6. If you need to void another transaction, search for the transaction by the amount or the last four digits of the customer's card number. Follow the prompts to locate the transaction and select "Yes" when the transaction is displayed. The receipt will print and the void is complete.

qa_pairs.question: How do I add a tip on a transaction using the Verifone card reader?
qa_pairs.answer: For VX520: 1. Press the second purple hot key from the left to open the Tip Adjust menu. 2. There are several ways to identify the transaction to be adjusted: - To search using the clerk/server ID who entered the transaction, press [F1]. - To search using the amount of sale, press [F2]. - To search using the last four digits of the customer's card number, press [F3]. - To search using the invoice number (printed on the receipt), press [F4]. 3. When the transaction detail displays, confirm it is the correct transaction and press [F1]. 4. Enter the tip amount, press [Enter], and you'll be done. For VX680: 1. Press the $ Icon to open the Tip Adjust menu. 2. There are several ways to identify the transaction to be adjusted: - To search using the clerk/server ID who entered the transaction, press [F1]. - To search using the amount of sale, press [F2]. - To search using the last four digits of the customer's card number, press [F3]. - To search using the invoice number (printed on the receipt), press [F4]. 3. Follow the prompts on your screen to locate the sale. When the transaction detail displays, press [F1] to confirm that this is the transaction you'd like to add a tip to. 4. Enter the tip amount, press [Enter], and you'll be done. **Note:** You can only add a tip to transactions in your current (open) batch. If the Tip Adjust option is not available on your Verifone card reader screen, call the Help Desk at 1-888-886-8869 to discuss modifying your setup options to add tip processing.

qa_pairs.question: How do I reprint receipts on the Verifone card reader?
qa_pairs.answer: For VX520: 1. To reprint a receipt, press the purple hot key furthest to the left to scroll down. 2. Press [F3] to select "Reprint." - To reprint the receipt for the most recent transaction, press [F2]. - To reprint the receipt from a different transaction, press [F3] and type in the invoice number for the receipt. - Press the green [Enter] key when you're finished. For VX680: 1. To reprint a receipt, press the Printer Icon on the bottom left of the screen. - Select "Reprint" to print the last transaction. - Select "Any Receipt" to reprint a previous transaction. - Follow the screen prompts to search for a previous transaction. - Press the green [Enter] key to reprint the receipt.

qa_pairs.question: How do I settle my batch of transactions on the Verifone card reader?
qa_pairs.answer: A settlement operation is used to close out the current (open) batch of transactions and start a new batch. The closed batch is then submitted to Chase to begin the funding process. Your Verifone card reader uses a Terminal Capture System (TCS), meaning it stores transactions throughout the day and sends batch totals of sales and refunds to Chase after the close of business. There are two settlement options: 1. **Manual Settlement:** - If your card reader is set to manually settle, press [F3] to select "Settlement" from the main menu, and then follow the prompts. 2. **Auto Settlement:** - If your card reader is set to automatically settle, it will automatically settle transactions in the current batch at a specific, predetermined time within a 24-hour period. - For example, if you set Auto Settlement to begin at 10 p.m., then every day at or after 10 p.m., any unsettled transactions in your batch will automatically be submitted for processing. This will occur as long as your card reader is powered on and connected to an available phone or Internet service. At the end of every successful batch settlement, a settlement report automatically prints from your Verifone card reader. Review any settlement printouts to confirm the batch settled successfully. To change your settlement option, call the Help Desk at 1-888-886-8869 and follow the call menu promptings for Technical Assistance.

qa_pairs.question: How do I run a report on my Verifone card reader?
qa_pairs.answer: Your Verifone card reader offers several reports that help you view details and summaries for the transactions in your open batch. For VX520: 1. Press the purple hot key furthest to the right to view the Reports menu. 2. Select a report to research your sales figures. For VX680: 1. Press the Report Icon (lower right corner) of the main screen. 2. The Report Menu will display. 3. Use the Arrow Icon to navigate through the Report Menu. 4. Tap the touchscreen to select the Report you wish to print. **Note:** Information in the Detail Report can be used to research a specific customer's transaction in your current (open) batch. Information in the Totals Report can be used to ensure your card reader totals are balancing with your registers. Running these Verifone card reader reports does not settle your batch or in any way alter the transactions that have been processed. For more reporting power and instant access to your merchant statement, Resource Online featuring the Instant Dashboard offers an at-a-glance view of your daily sales and settlement figures from any computer.

qa_pairs.question: How do I install a new paper roll in the Verifone card reader?
qa_pairs.answer: 1. Gently pull the latch located on the bottom of the card reader to unlock the paper cover. 2. Lift the printer cover up and back. 3. Loosen the glued leading edge of the paper or remove the protective strip from the new roll of paper. Unwind the paper roll past any glue residue. 4. Hold the roll so the paper feeds from the bottom of the roll when the card reader is facing you. 5. Drop the paper roll into the printer tray inverted. 6. Pull the paper up past the glue residue on the paper roll. 7. Close the paper roll cover by gently pressing directly on the cover until it clicks. 8. Tear the paper off against the serrated plastic strip in the printer.

qa_pairs.question: How do I troubleshoot the printer on the Verifone card reader?
qa_pairs.answer: If receipts are not printing and a "no paper" error displays on your Verifone card reader: 1. Open the paper compartment. 2. Remove the paper roll and check for any jammed paper. 3. When finished, replace the paper roll and close the compartment. If the paper advances from the printer during transactions but is blank: 1. Make sure you are using thermal-sensitive paper, not plain paper. You can verify this by running your fingernail down the side of the paper – it should leave a line. 2. Make sure that the paper roll is loaded so that the paper feeds from the bottom of the roll.

qa_pairs.question: How do I change the date or time on my Verifone card reader?
qa_pairs.answer: For VX520: 1. Press the star key to ensure you are at the operating system home screen. Then press [F2] and [F4] at the same time. If prompted, input the Terminal password and press Enter. 2. To change the time, press the far left purple key to scroll down and use the number pad to select the option that correlates to "Clock," then select the option that correlates to "Edit Time." 3. Using Military time, type six digits comprised of a two-digit format: Hour, Minutes, and Seconds, and press Enter. Press Cancel if the Time and Date appear on the screen. 4. To change the date, use the number pad to select the option that correlates to "Edit Date." 5. Type six digits comprised of the two-digit month, day, and year, and press Enter. 6. The terminal screen will display the current Time and Date. 7. Press Cancel until the restart option displays, then using the number pad press the number that correlates to "Restart" to restart the terminal and return to the idle prompt. For VX680: 1. Press the star key to ensure you are at the operating system home screen. Then press Enter and [7] at the same time. 2. If prompted, input the Terminal password and press Enter. 3. Press the Down Arrow located on the far left portion of the touch screen to scroll to the next menu. 4. To change the time, use the number pad to select the option that correlates to "Clock," then select the option that correlates to "Edit Time." 5. Using Military time, type six digits comprised of a two-digit format: Hour, Minutes, and Seconds, and press Enter, then press Cancel. 6. To change the date, use the number pad to select the option that correlates to "Edit Date." Type six digits comprised of the two-digit month, day, and year, and press Enter. 7. Press Cancel until "Restart" displays, then using the number pad press the option that correlates to "Restart" to return to the idle prompt.

qa_pairs.question: How do I put a Chase terminal into Semi-Integrated Mode?
qa_pairs.answer: Setup: Retail POS for Mac/PC Retail POS on iPad Chase payment integration Ingenico Desk 5000/iCT250 Steps: Press the # key and enter the manager password provided by Chase. Go back to the Semi-Integrated menu, select 2-Communication Type, and choose 3-Ethernet. Enter the Port number 9999 and confirm.

qa_pairs.question: How do I pair an Ingenico Desk and Move with Chase Canada on eConduit?
qa_pairs.answer: Setup: Retail POS for Mac or PC Retail POS on iPad Desk 3500/5000 and Move 5000 eConduit application and semi-integrated (TSI) application Steps: Confirm Semi-Integrated Mode: Select Admin or #. Go to #9 Misc Options and select #1 for semi-integrated. Enable Semi Integrated to "on". Confirm Communication type (Ethernet for Desk 3500/5000 and WiFi for Move 5000). Set Port to 5020 and Receipt options to Terminal. Activate eConduit App: Select Function Key and eConduit icon. Click "Cloud Server" and "Start Cloud Server". Print Configuration to get Terminal ID. Create Payment Type in Retail POS: Log into Retail POS and go to Setup -> Payment Types. Click Add Payment Type and select Retail POS Payment Gateway. Name the payment type (e.g., Credit/Debit). Select outlets and save the payment type. Pair the Terminal in Retail POS: Select the Retail POS Payment Gateway created above. Click Pair a terminal and enter the Terminal ID from the configuration slip. Save Payment Type.

qa_pairs.question: How do I configure my Desk 5000 to integrate with Retail POS (X-Series)?
qa_pairs.answer: Setup: Retail POS for Mac or PC Desk 5000 Steps: Enable Semi-Integrated Mode: Select the # key on the terminal pad. Enter Admin name and password. On the Admin menu, select 9-Misc. qa_pairs.question: How do I reprint a receipt on a Desk/Move 5000 terminal?
qa_pairs.answer: Setup: Desk/Move 5000 Steps: In the lower left-hand corner of the screen, select [SEMI]. Confirm to switch to Standalone Mode. Press [8] for Desk 5000 or [7] for Move 5000. Choose [1] to print the last receipt, [2] to search for a receipt. Select [1] to print Merchant Copy only, [2] for Customer Copy only, [3] for both copies. Return to Semi-Integrated Mode: In the lower left-hand corner, select [S/A]. Confirm to switch to Semi-Integrated Mode.

qa_pairs.question: How do I pair a Global Payments Canada Desk 5000 terminal to Retail POS (X-Series)?
qa_pairs.answer: Setup: Retail POS for Mac or PC Ingenico Desk 5000 and iCT 220/250 Ethernet Port 8150 (Desk 5000) and 1101 (iCT 220/250) Fiska Payment Bridge Steps: Create Payment Type in Retail POS: Log into Retail POS and go to Setup -> Payment Types. Click Add Payment Type and select Global Payments. Click Begin Setup. Configure Payment Type: Name the payment type (e.g., Credit/Debit). Click Save Payment Type. Pair the Terminal: Prepare the Terminal: Connect the terminal to the network with an Ethernet cable. Connect the power cable and turn the terminal on. Ensure the terminal is on the same IP network/subnet as the Retail POS register. Pair Terminal: Navigate to the Sell screen, add a product, and click Pay. Select the payment type created for Global Payments. If the Payment Bridge is not installed, Retail POS will prompt to download and install it. Install Payment Bridge: Click the payment button created for Global Payments. The system will detect and prompt to install the Payment Bridge Application. After installation, the Payment Bridge will search for terminals and pair automatically. Complete a transaction to authorize payment and Retail POS will display a `Payment Received' message. Refund Transaction: Perform a second transaction to refund the amount from the first transaction.

qa_pairs.question: How do I set up Multi-Lane on Fiska?
qa_pairs.answer: Setup: Processing via Elavon US/CA, TD Bank, Nuvei US/CA, Global Payments CA, Chase CA/US PC/Mac Ingenico iCT200/250 or Desk/Move 5000 Steps: Ensure the Fiska payment type is enabled in Retail POS. Pair Remaining Terminals: If prompted, use another terminal, ensuring it matches the correct register. Repeat the process for each terminal. Additional Info: Only one payment type is needed per register. Use process of elimination if MAC Address is not visible.
